meta.title: Six practices — CRM, automation, integrations, AI | Project Nidos
meta.description: Six implementation practices with a fixed scope and a price from EUR 3,000: CRM, sales and customer service automation, warehouse and accounting integrations, AI and e-commerce.

hero.ledeHTML: CRM, sales and customer service automation, systems integration, AI and e-commerce — implemented through to a measurable result, at a fixed scope and from EUR 3,000.

items.text: AI solution for a specific process

practices.heading: Six practices, each with a fixed scope and a price.

items.title: CRM implementation
items.outcome: One CRM system and a transparent sales pipeline.
items.body: Project Nidos helps companies select, configure and implement a CRM system that brings together customer data, sales processes, tasks, communication and sales analytics.
items.problemText: Customer data and sales work are spread across different locations and systems.
items.pkgBody: Up to five users, one sales pipeline, up to ten custom fields, email integration, up to 500 importable records, two training sessions and 14 days of post-implementation support.
items.priceNote: Typical projects EUR 3,000–60,000 · excl. VAT, licences and third-party costs

items.title: Sales process automation
items.outcome: An automated lead journey from initial interest to completed transaction.
items.body: Project Nidos helps companies reduce manual sales work and create a controllable process from initial customer interest through to the transaction and post-sales communication.
items.problemText: Leads are lost and follow-up communication is performed manually.
scope: CRM, email, Forms, WhatsApp and other tool integrations
items.pkgBody: A sales process audit, integration of one lead-generation channel, automatic lead assignment, three to five follow-up scenarios, sales pipeline KPIs, sales team training and a 30-day results review.
items.priceNote: Typical projects EUR 4,000–70,000 · excl. VAT, licences and third-party costs

items.title: Customer service automation
items.outcome: Centralised support, a knowledge base and AI assistance.
items.body: Project Nidos helps reduce manual customer support work by improving response times and centralising customer information.
items.problemText: Responses are delayed and employees repeatedly answer the same questions.
scope: connection of conversation history to the CRM
items.pkgBody: A customer support process audit, knowledge base structure, up to 50 frequently asked questions, an AI response assistant, human escalation, one website or email channel integration, conversation logging and 30 days of monitoring.
items.priceNote: Typical projects EUR 4,000–40,000 · excl. VAT, licences and third-party costs

items.title: Warehouse or accounting system integration
items.outcome: Synchronised orders, inventory, invoices and customer data.
items.body: Project Nidos connects warehouse, accounting, e-commerce, CRM and payment systems so that data does not have to be entered multiple times.
items.problemText: The same data has to be entered into multiple systems.
scope: inventory levels with online store stock updates
data synchronisation through APIs, webhooks or automation platforms
items.pkgBody: An audit of existing systems and data flows, design of one primary integration scenario, API or webhook connection, data-field mapping, error log, testing, documentation and 30 days of warranty support.
items.priceNote: Typical projects EUR 4,000–60,000 · excl. VAT, licences and third-party costs

items.title: AI solution for a specific process
items.outcome: A measurable reduction in time, cost or errors.
items.body: Project Nidos delivers AI as an improvement to a specific business process with a measurable result, rather than as a general AI consulting project.
items.problemText: Employees spend time on repetitive work.
items.pkgBody: Assessment of one business process, data and security requirements analysis, an AI solution prototype, integration with one business system, user testing, measurement of accuracy and time savings, and a production implementation plan.
items.pkgNote: Third-party AI model costs, API usage, data storage and special security requirements are charged separately.
items.priceNote: Typical projects EUR 4,000–100,000 · excl. VAT, licences and third-party costs

items.title: E-commerce and payment integration
items.outcome: A secure, connected order, payment, delivery and accounting flow.
items.body: Project Nidos creates or improves e-commerce infrastructure connecting the online store with payments, inventory, delivery, accounting, CRM and customer communications.
items.problemText: The online store and payment flow are not sufficiently connected to the rest of the business systems.
scope: Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop or custom store development
Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and SEPA integration
analytics, conversion tracking and GDPR requirements
items.pkgBody: Technical online-store configuration, up to 100 products, Stripe or another payment solution integration, Apple Pay and Google Pay where available, order-status processing, email notifications, delivery configuration, basic analytics setup and test purchases.
items.priceNote: Typical projects EUR 3,000–200,000 · excl. VAT, licences and third-party costs

steps.body: A fixed-price project with a clearly defined scope.

steps.title: Scaling
steps.body: Additional integrations, users, automations and AI features.
